name: cx-goal-one-rule~p2
task: Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Open the door, then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' — key_lost is already defined as the key being lost before the door opened, so the condition is baked into the proposition and a plain (soft) Absence is right, with no Precedence. The hard Existence(target_picked_up) plus the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) capture 'Open the door, then pick up the box': the pair forces door_open without a redundant Existence(door_open), and FINAL_STATES u3 confirms the goal is reachable. The prerequisites (moving the ball, taking the key) are environment-guaranteed and unstated, so omitting them is correct.

texts: The agent tries not to lose the key while the door is still closed.
The door is opened before the target box is picked up.
The target box in the other room is eventually picked up.
